platforms.label: Confluence
platforms.description: Atlassian Confluence: Cloud, Data Center or Server.

kinds.label: Email and API token
kinds.help: Atlassian Cloud: create the token at id.atlassian.com under Security > API tokens.

kinds.label: Personal access token
kinds.help: Data Center, and Server 7.9 or later: create it in your profile under Personal Access Tokens.

kinds.label: User and password
kinds.help: Server before 7.9, which has no personal access tokens.

fields.label: Confluence address
fields.help: The address of the site, https. Any page address of the site works.

fields.label: Space
fields.help: The space the pages go in.

fields.label: Parent page
fields.help: The page the tree hangs under.
fields.patternHelp: The parent page is a page id: digits only. Search for it by title to fill it in.

fields.label: Title prefix
fields.help: Pages are titled "<prefix>: <first heading>". Starts as the parent page's title.

choices.label: Files to Confluence
choices.help: Files are the source; the platform is overwritten.

choices.label: Both ways
choices.help: Edits made on the platform are pulled back into the files.

choices.label: Image
choices.help: A code macro plus an SVG attachment.

fields.label: Title already exists
fields.help: What to do when an unsynced file's title already exists on the platform.

fields.label: Template
fields.help: How the pages are laid out: a page id or address, or a file, with {{content}} where the page goes. Empty is the default layout.

platforms.label: GitHub Pages
platforms.description: A static site published to a branch of a GitHub repository.

fields.label: Repository
fields.help: "owner/name" or a clone URL. Empty means this workspace's own origin.
fields.patternHelp: Use owner/name or a clone URL, or leave it empty for this workspace's own origin.

fields.label: Folder in the branch
fields.help: The folder inside the branch the site goes to, so another site can share the branch. Empty owns the whole branch.

fields.label: Template
fields.help: A built-in layout, or a folder holding template.html. Write ./name for a folder named like a built-in.

fields.label: Repository
fields.help: "owner/name" or a clone URL. Empty means this workspace's own origin.
fields.patternHelp: Use owner/name or a clone URL, or leave it empty for this workspace's own origin.

fields.label: Branch
fields.help: The wiki's branch. Empty means its default branch.

fields.label: Template
fields.help: A Markdown file with {{content}} where the page goes. Empty is the default layout.

outputFields.label: Name
outputFields.help: What this output is called in the tree, the sync and the settings, so two of the same platform are told apart. Empty shows a name made from the platform and where it goes.

outputFields.label: Include
outputFields.help: Gitignore-style patterns this output reads even though an ignore or exclude list leaves them out.

outputFields.label: Exclude
outputFields.help: Gitignore-style patterns this output leaves out, on top of the workspace's ignore list.

contentFields.label: Folders to sync
contentFields.help: Folders relative to the workspace. "." is the whole workspace.

contentFields.label: Excluded paths
contentFields.help: Gitignore-style patterns this storage leaves out.

generators.label: Markdown documents
generators.description: Existing documents brought in as pages.

generators.label: TypeScript documentation
generators.description: TypeScript and JavaScript source documentation, through TypeDoc.

fields.label: Storybook
fields.help: The URL of a Storybook, or the workspace folder of its build. Input then filters the stories by title (Components/, !Internal/).

generatorFields.label: Type
generatorFields.help: What the generator reads. Empty recognises the type from input.

choices.label: Markdown documents
choices.help: Existing documents brought in as pages.

choices.label: TypeScript documentation
choices.help: TypeScript and JavaScript source documentation, through TypeDoc.

generatorFields.label: Output folder
generatorFields.help: The folder, inside the workspace, the pages are written to. Include it in an output's content roots for the pages to sync.

generatorFields.label: Input
generatorFields.help: Gitignore-style patterns selecting what to read. Empty means the type's own default.

generatorFields.label: Index page title
generatorFields.help: Heads the generated index page. Empty means the type's own default.

generatorFields.label: Prepare command
generatorFields.help: A shell command that produces what the generator reads (a build, a test run). It runs only when a run asks for it, never on its own.

settings.label: Ignore
settings.help: Gitignore-style patterns every output leaves out of the scan, for example CLAUDE.md or internal/.

settings.label: Skip git-ignored files
settings.help: Leave out Markdown that the workspace's .gitignore files ignore.

settings.label: Confluence address
settings.help: The Confluence address every output uses unless it sets its own. Set it once in the user's settings; a project overrides it. The token is never a setting.

settings.label: Default direction
settings.help: The direction of an output that does not set one. Empty means files to platform.

settings.label: Default Mermaid mode
settings.help: How Mermaid diagrams are stored in an output that does not set it. Empty means image.

settings.label: Default link mode
settings.help: How links between pages are written in an output that does not set it. Empty means title.

settings.label: Default title collision
settings.help: What to do when an unsynced file's title already exists, in an output that does not set it. Empty means fail.

settings.label: Default title prefix
settings.help: The title prefix of an output that does not set one. Empty means the first sync asks for one.

settings.label: Generate before every sync
settings.help: Run the generators (test results, API documentation) before every sync, so the pages they write are as fresh as the code.

settings.label: Run prepare commands
settings.help: Whether a generator's prepare command runs when you generate. Ask shows the exact commands first.

settings.label: Watch mode wait
settings.help: In watch mode, how many seconds nothing may change before the changes are synced, so a burst of saves is one sync.

settings.label: Use the system keychain
settings.help: Remember connections in the operating system's keychain, so every editor and the command line share them and a token is entered once.

settings.label: Default formats
settings.help: The formats ticked by default when you export a Markdown file.

settings.label: Export folder
settings.help: Where exported files go. Empty writes each next to its Markdown file. A folder receives the exports with the document's own folders mirrored below it.

settings.label: PDF page size
settings.help: The paper a PDF export is printed on.

settings.label: PNG width
settings.help: The width in pixels of a PNG export. The image is as tall as the page.

settings.label: Word template
settings.help: A Word file used as the company template for DOCX exports: styles, numbering, headers, footers and page setup are taken from it. Relative to the project, or absolute.

settings.label: OpenDocument template
settings.help: An OpenDocument file used as the company template for ODT exports. Relative to the project, or absolute.

settings.label: Browser for PDF and PNG
settings.help: The Chrome, Edge or Chromium that prints PDF and PNG exports. Empty uses the one installed in the usual place.
